role: OvernightStreamingCoordinator extension: starts overnight BLE streaming, runs the 1 Hz tick with incremental backup, merges resumed segments onto the parent, and runs the blocking morning stop (strap download + parallel sleep poll + analysis + finalize), including the streaming-short fallback.
types: selectBestDataSource: file-private func — morning source choice

flags.text: The 120-beat usability threshold exists three times: minimumUsableBeats, the literal 120 in selectBestDataSource and DataSourceSelector.minimumValidBeats.

units.does: Returns true when the session's provenance model name contains 'verity' or 'sense'; with no provenance, true when the live connected device is a Verity Sense.

branches.effect: true: string match on model name ('verity' || 'sense'); false: live device type check

units.does: Builds a .failed HRVSession with the base id/start/type, publishes it as currentSession, sets lastError = insufficientData and clears morningStatus; returns it.

flags.text: failSession does not move recordingPhase off .analyzing (set by publishGatherSavingState before the gate), so after a failed morning stop or failed gather the phase stays .analyzing until the user triggers resetSession; meanwhile the device-recording binding only promotes from .idle and the live-HRV assistant mirror reports the session as analyzing.

units.does: Starts an overnight/nap streaming session: requires a connected, non-streaming strap, starts diagnostics sampling, creates the session with streaming provenance, records the capture choice, starts PolarManager streaming, launches the H10 arming loop when backup is on and the device is not Verity Sense, resets state, starts HealthKit sleep/vitals observers, persists recording state, logs and starts the 1 Hz timer.

branches.cond: useDeviceInternalBackup and device is not Verity Sense
branches.effect: true: launch arming loop; false: streaming only

flags.text: The diagnostics sampler is started before polarManager.startStreaming(); if startStreaming throws the function exits with the 5 s memory/thermal sampler still running and nothing stops it until a later recording ends.

units.does: Resets collector state for a new overnight session: currentSession, empty points, start time, streaming/overnight/collecting flags, recordingPhase .overnightStreaming, unbounded target, counters zeroed, fetch/backup/ending flags cleared, deviceFetchPolicy .automatic.
Starts HealthKit observers for sleep and vitals so Watch syncs trigger rescoring.
Warns about low strap battery and debug-logs the session start (backup mode, id, type, device id).
Invalidates any streaming timer and schedules a repeating 1 s Timer (tolerance 0.25 s) whose block hops to the main actor and runs overnightStreamingTick.

1 Hz tick: increments elapsed seconds, every 30 s rechecks strap battery staleness, detects a reconnect by comparing streamingReconnectCount, and runs the incremental backup (forced after a reconnect).
units.entry: Timer block scheduled by startOvernightStreamingTimer (1 Hz).

branches.cond: not overnight streaming or timer nil

branches.effect: log and record new count; backup forced

units.does: Calls RawRRBackup.incrementalBackup with the whole streamed buffer (internally throttled); when it wrote, uploads the buffer as a CloudKit live backup in a utility Task.

For a resumed child, loads the first linked (parent) session from the archive and prepends its beats to the child's beats offset onto the parent's clock, returning a base session re-anchored to the parent's start; otherwise returns the input unchanged.

branches.cond: no linked id, parent not found, or parent has no beats

units.does: Shifts the child's t_ms and wallClockMs by the ms offset between child start and parent start; nil when the offset is non-positive or unrepresentable.
Builds an .analyzing HRVSession with the child's id/type/provenance/links/pausedDate but the parent's startDate and the child's endDate (or now).
True when either source has >=120 beats, or for a resumed child when any beat exists.

Morning stop: ends arming, tears down streaming and publishes the saving state, backs up the beats, then either takes the device-fetch fallback (insufficient streaming) or downloads/merges/scores the night and disconnects a Verity Sense.

flags.text: The Verity Sense auto-disconnect runs only on the good-streaming path; a Verity Sense night that falls to fallbackToDeviceFetch (which always fails for Verity Sense) leaves the sensor connected.

units.does: True when streamed beats >= 120, or the session is a resumed child with any beats.
Disconnects the strap when the night was a Verity Sense night.
Fetches the strap file and sleep concurrently, chooses the data source, then analyses and finalizes the night.
Runs the parallel HealthKit sleep poll (async let) while awaiting the strap download; returns both.
Returns the cached SleepData covering the recording when it has night sleep and plausibly overlaps the recording; else nil.

branches.cond: no cache entry, zero sleep, or implausible overlap

units.does: Sleep fast-path during the device fetch: cache hit returns at once; otherwise up to 3 HealthKit attempts 2 s apart, aborting on protected-data errors.

branches.effect: each attempt then 2 s sleep, including after the last attempt
fall through to the 2 s sleep
break out of the loop, return nil

flags.text: The 2 s sleep runs after the 3rd failed attempt too, adding 2 s to the result before returning nil (it only matters when the poll outlasts the strap download it runs alongside).

units.does: One HealthKit sleep fetch: found when nightSleepMinutes > 0, retry otherwise or on any error except HK errorDatabaseInaccessible, which aborts.

The single overnight strap-download gate: resets the transfer-cancel flag, returns nil (and stops any device recording) when Skip/streaming-only/Verity Sense; otherwise reconnects and downloads the recording since the session start, honours a Skip tapped during the download, reports a failed read, and returns the strap beats on the night's clock. Always resets deviceFetchPolicy to .automatic on exit.

branches.cond: user tapped Skip during the download
branches.effect: stop device recording, return nil (downloaded data discarded)

units.does: Returns false (with a log line) when the user skipped, the capture mode is streaming-only, or the device is a Verity Sense; true otherwise.
Reconnects the strap for transfer (bounded); on success fetches the recording made since start and logs the timing.
After a failed strap read: if the stream's wall-clock gap is under 10 min logs an external note only; otherwise logs and sets lastError = strapStillHoldsNight(missingMinutes).

flags.text: The strapStillHoldsNight error set here is overwritten by failSession's insufficientData on the fallback path (streaming < 120 beats → fetch fails → failSession), which is exactly the night with the largest stream gap; debugLogExternal is diagnostic-only, so the user is not told to recover the strap's copy before the next recording clears it.

units.does: Minutes of wall clock the streamed beats do not cover: (last-first wallClockMs) − (last-first t_ms), floored at 0; 0 when the endpoints lack wall clock.

branches.cond: no points or endpoints lack wallClockMs

units.does: Clears isDeviceFetchInProgress, stops timer and sampler, clears isStreamingMode before stopping streaming, captures base session/reconnect count/elapsed hours, stops PolarManager streaming and publishes the saving state; returns (base, beats, reconnects).
Writes points to RawRRBackup on a detached utility task and awaits it; failure logged.

Merges any parent segment, publishes .analyzing, runs processOvernightData (foreground: publishes result and pre-archives), clears persisted recording state, shows .complete for 1 s then clears and updates the baseline tracker; returns the final session.
Sets morningStatus to the complete status, holds 1 s, clears it, and folds the session into BaselineTracker with the current sleep schedule.
Sleeps 1 s; a non-cancellation interruption is logged.
Streaming-short morning: downloads the strap file through the same gate; with fewer than 120 device beats (or none) fails the session; else picks device-first source and finalizes.
Uses DataSourceSelector to see whether streaming fills device gaps; falls back to device points labelled 'internal'.

flags.text: The only caller guarantees devicePoints.count >= 120, and DataSourceSelector.selectBestSource never returns nil when internal points reach 120, so the else branch cannot run.

units.does: Fallback finalize: merges parent, publishes .analyzing, runs processOvernightData, clears persisted recording state, sets currentSession, then settles the morning status and updates the baseline.
Builds a DeviceProvenance for live streaming from the connected strap's id and display name.
Morning source choice: with fewer than 120 device beats uses streaming (deviceBeats nil); otherwise DataSourceSelector's choice with deviceBeats = device count.

branches.effect: return it; else streaming with device count

flags.text: With dp.count >= 120 guaranteed by the guard, selectBestSource always returns a selection, so the final streaming return (lines 818-819) is dead.
